Caloosa Riders Sunday Welcome Ride

Fort Myers, FL · Road

No-dropBeginner friendly

Caloosa Riders Sunday Welcome Ride is a road group ride in Fort Myers, FL. It rolls every Sunday at 7:30 am from Trek Bicycle Fort Myers. About 25 miles, 14–16 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 14–16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Caloosa Riders Sunday Welcome Ride group ride

The club's entry-level weekly ride. Mostly on the path system around the shop, with a different destination each week. First Sunday of the month goes to the pancake breakfast at Page Field. You should be able to hold 14–16 mph for an hour and a half. Helmets required.
